major_risks.risk: Boeing depends heavily on commercial airlines, so a downturn in the economy or the airline industry, or financial trouble at major customers, could reduce orders, deliveries, revenues and cash flows.

Boeing's commercial aircraft programs (777X, 737-7, 737-10 and others) face certification, production-rate and delivery risks, which have already caused large reach-forward losses (777X: $4.9 billion in 2025) and customer remedies.
Fixed-price aircraft contracts expose Boeing to losses if cost overruns occur or if its costs rise faster than the contractual price escalation.
